description: Code for Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
summary: The core idea is clean: instead of the O(n²) scan, LSA pools keys into latent-space clusters and lets each query score only the bucket centroids before attending to the selected long-range keys plus a local window, which is the same hierarchical-index trick I grew up with in read alignment, just applied to attention. What sells it to me is that the kernel is untouched and D-LSA distills the indexer onto a pre-trained model, so it ships as a drop-in SGLang plugin rather than a new architecture, meaning I could wire it into the agent sessions PenguPool routes without retraining a thing. The training-free PCA variant is the kind of small, local-first experiment I'd run on a single GPU before deciding whether a full distillation pass is worth the cluster time.
